opportunities.title: KI-Terminbuchung am Telefon
opportunities.reason: Direkt kaufnah: Nutzer suchen nicht nur KI, sondern eine konkrete Terminbuchungsfunktion.
opportunities.implementation: Static feature page with booking flow, calendar safety rules, visible FAQ answers, matching SoftwareApplication/Service JSON-LD, links to Friseur, Kosmetikstudio, Fitnessstudio, Kontakt.

opportunities.title: KI-Anrufannahme 24/7
opportunities.reason: Sehr nah am Kernproblem von Phonbot und breit genug fuer interne Verlinkung aus allen Branchen.
opportunities.implementation: Static feature page with use cases, after-hours routing, no-false-promise section, FAQ, links from hero/footer/blog.

opportunities.title: KI-Telefonassistent vs Telefonservice
opportunities.reason: Comparison pages sind kaufnah und koennen Einwaende zu Vertrauen, Datenschutz, Kosten und Qualitaet sauber abholen.
opportunities.implementation: Neutral comparison with cost bands, response-time table, privacy caveats, FAQ, strong internal links.

opportunities.title: KI-Telefonassistent fuer Steuerberater
opportunities.reason: Professional-services niche with clear phone pain and lead value; risk manageable with no-tax-advice guardrails.
opportunities.implementation: Industry page for appointment intake, document reminders, callback tickets, no tax advice, visible FAQ answers and matching service schema.

opportunities.title: KI-Telefonassistent Berlin
opportunities.reason: Mindrails/Phonbot has Germany/Berlin context; local intent can be valuable if content stays genuinely local.
opportunities.implementation: Local page only if it has real local proof: Berlin phone demo, German hosting context, local service area text, ContactPoint schema.

opportunities.title: KI-Telefonassistent fuer Zahnarztpraxen
opportunities.reason: High-value appointment niche, but higher compliance risk because medical-adjacent claims must be carefully limited.
opportunities.implementation: Industry page focused on appointment intake, recall, emergencies-to-human, no medical advice, strong disclaimers.

opportunities.title: KI-Telefonassistent fuer Kanzleien
opportunities.reason: High lead value, but YMYL/legal risk means this must be intake-only and human-reviewed.
opportunities.implementation: Only build with strict legal-disclaimer and intake positioning: no Rechtsberatung, conflict-check routing, urgent deadlines to human.

opportunities.title: KI-Telefonassistent Kosten 2026
opportunities.reason: There is an ROI article, but a clearer cost guide can capture price-intent queries and support conversion.
opportunities.implementation: Blog guide with transparent Phonbot plans, total cost factors, examples by call volume, links to pricing/register.

opportunities.title: Anrufbeantworter Alternative fuer kleine Unternehmen
opportunities.audience: Betriebe, die Mailbox/AB als ungenuegend erleben
opportunities.reason: Guter SEO-Hebel, weil Nutzer ihr Problem bereits benennen, aber noch nicht zwingend nach KI suchen.
opportunities.implementation: Comparison-style guide: Mailbox vs Sekretariat vs KI-Telefonassistent, honest limits, CTA to demo.

opportunities.title: Rufweiterleitung Telekom, Vodafone und O2 fuer KI-Telefonie
opportunities.reason: Setup queries are practical, low-risk and likely to convert after technical success.
opportunities.implementation: Provider-specific setup overview with caveat to verify current carrier UI, screenshots only if maintained.

opportunities.title: City x Industry Matrix
opportunities.reason: Potentially large reach, but risky if pages become thin or duplicate. Should start with 3 hand-written pilots.
opportunities.implementation: Pilot only: Berlin x Friseur, Berlin x Handwerker, Berlin x Zahnarzt. Require local proof, unique FAQs and Search Console validation before scaling.

opportunities.title: DSGVO und KI-Telefonassistenten
opportunities.reason: Bestehende Blogartikel decken DSGVO an, aber eine evergreen Trust-Landingpage kann intern und extern staerker ranken.
opportunities.implementation: Evergreen page with processing overview, retention, AVV, sub-processors, no legal advice wording and visible FAQ answers.

guidance.label: Google SEO Starter Guide
guidance.principle: Make content easy for search engines to understand and useful for users.

guidance.label: Google structured data guidelines
guidance.principle: Structured data must match visible page content and is eligibility, not a guarantee.

guidance.label: Google AI features optimization guide
guidance.principle: AI search visibility follows the same people-first, crawlable, well-structured content rules.
